# Documentação do Evolution Foundation

> Documentação oficial do desenvolvedor para Evolution Foundation - a plataforma de engajamento de clientes alimentada por IA. Aprenda sobre nossas APIs, integrações e diretrizes de desenvolvimento.

## Docs

- [Autenticação nas APIs EvoAI](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/api-reference/authentication.md): Guia completo de autenticação com API Access Token (UUID) e multi-tenant para todas as APIs Evo CRM
- [Introdução às APIs](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/api-reference/introduction.md): Documentação completa das APIs REST disponíveis na plataforma para integrações, automações e desenvolvimento.
- [Create agent](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/create-agent.md): Create a new agent
- [Create api key](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/create-api-key.md): Create a new api key
- [Create custom mcp server](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/create-custom-mcp-server.md): Create a new custom mcp server
- [Create custom tool](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/create-custom-tool.md): Create a new custom tool
- [Create mcp server](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/create-mcp-server.md): Create a new mcp server
- [Delete agent](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/delete-agent.md): Delete a agent
- [Delete agent integration](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/delete-agent-integration.md): Delete an agent integration
- [Delete api key](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/delete-api-key.md): Delete a api key
- [Delete custom mcp server](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/delete-custom-mcp-server.md): Delete a custom mcp server
- [Delete custom tool](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/delete-custom-tool.md): Delete a custom tool
- [Delete mcp server](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/delete-mcp-server.md): Delete a mcp server
- [Get agent by id](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/get-agent-by-id.md): Get a agent by id
- [Get agent integration by provider](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/get-agent-integration-by-provider.md): Get an agent integration by provider name
- [Get api key by id](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/get-api-key-by-id.md): Get a api key by id
- [Get custom mcp server by id](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/get-custom-mcp-server-by-id.md): Get a custom mcp server by id
- [Get custom tool by id](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/get-custom-tool-by-id.md): Get a custom tool by id
- [Get mcp server by id](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/get-mcp-server-by-id.md): Get a mcp server by id
- [Get share agent](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/get-share-agent.md): Get a share agent
- [Get shared agent](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/get-shared-agent.md): Get a shared agent
- [Import agents](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/import-agents.md): Import one or more agents from a JSON file
- [List agent integrations](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/list-agent-integrations.md): List all integrations for an agent
- [List agents by client id](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/list-agents-by-client-id.md): List all agents with pagination by client id
- [List api keys by client id](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/list-api-keys-by-client-id.md): List all api keys with pagination by client id
- [List custom mcp servers by client id](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/list-custom-mcp-servers-by-client-id.md): List all custom mcp servers with pagination by client id
- [List custom tools by client id](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/list-custom-tools-by-client-id.md): List all custom tools with pagination by client id
- [List mcp servers](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/list-mcp-servers.md): List all mcp servers with pagination
- [Sync Evolution bot](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/sync-evolution-bot.md): Sync agent with Evolution bot
- [Test custom mcp server](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/test-custom-mcp-server.md): Test a custom mcp server
- [Test custom tool](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/test-custom-tool.md): Test a custom tool
- [Update agent](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/update-agent.md): Update a agent
- [Update api key](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/update-api-key.md): Update a api key
- [Update custom mcp server](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/update-custom-mcp-server.md): Update a custom mcp server
- [Update custom tool](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/update-custom-tool.md): Update a custom tool
- [Update mcp server](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/update-mcp-server.md): Update a mcp server
- [Upsert agent integration](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-core/upsert-agent-integration.md): Create or update an agent integration
- [Add a New Agent](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/add-a-new-agent.md): Add a new Agent to Inbox
- [Add a subtask to a task](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/add-a-subtask-to-a-task.md): Create a subtask under an existing task (max 3 hierarchy levels)
- [Add an item to pipeline](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/add-an-item-to-pipeline.md): Add a conversation or contact to the pipeline
- [Add Labels](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/add-labels.md): Add labels to a conversation. Note that this API would overwrite the existing list of labels associated to the conversation.
- [Add or remove agent bot](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/add-or-remove-agent-bot.md): To add an agent bot pass agent_bot id, to remove agent bot from an inbox pass null
- [Archive a pipeline](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/archive-a-pipeline.md): Set pipeline as inactive
- [Assign Conversation](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/assign-conversation.md): Assign a conversation to an agent or a team
- [Attach Products](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/attach-products.md): Attaches one or more products to the agent. After the attach succeeds, the service triggers `Ai::AgentProductSyncService` to update the agent's config in evo-ai-core-service.
- [Bulk move items to a stage](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/bulk-move-items-to-a-stage.md): Move multiple items to a new stage at once
- [Bulk Transfer Contacts](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/bulk-transfer-contacts.md): Transfer multiple contacts to different account or assignee
- [Cancel a task](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/cancel-a-task.md)
- [Cancel scheduled action](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/cancel-scheduled-action.md): Marks the scheduled action as cancelled, preventing its execution
- [Change task position among siblings](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/change-task-position-among-siblings.md): Reorder a task within its current parent's subtasks
- [Contact Conversations](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/contact-conversations.md): Get conversations associated with that contact
- [Contact Filter](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/contact-filter.md): Filter contacts with custom filter options and pagination
- [Conversation Details](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/conversation-details.md): Get all details regarding a conversation with all messages in the conversation
- [Conversations Filter](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/conversations-filter.md): Filter conversations with custom filter options and pagination
- [Conversations List](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/conversations-list.md): List all the conversations with pagination
- [Create a new macro](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-a-new-macro.md): Creates a new macro with the specified actions
- [Create a new pipeline](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-a-new-pipeline.md): Create a pipeline with optional custom stages or default stages based on pipeline type
- [Create a new stage](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-a-new-stage.md): Add a new stage to the pipeline
- [Create a new task](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-a-new-task.md): Add a task to a pipeline item
- [Create an inbox](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-an-inbox.md): You can create more than one website inbox in each account
- [Create Contact](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-contact.md): Create a new Contact
- [Create contact inbox](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-contact-inbox.md): Create a contact inbox record for an inbox
- [Create Contact Note](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-contact-note.md): Creates a new note for the contact
- [Create Lead](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-lead.md): Create a lead (contact + deal) in one API call. This endpoint creates a contact and automatically adds it to a pipeline stage.
- [Create Message](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-message.md): Creates a new message in the conversation
- [Create Message Template](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-message-template.md): Creates a new WhatsApp message template
- [Create New Conversation](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-new-conversation.md): Creating a conversation in Evolution requires a source id.
- [Create Product](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-product.md): Creates a new product in the catalog. Requires `products.create`.
- [Create scheduled action](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-scheduled-action.md): Schedules a new action to be executed at a specific time
- [Create Variant](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/create-variant.md): Creates a new variant under the product. Requires `products.update`.
- [Delete a macro](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/delete-a-macro.md): Permanently deletes a macro
- [Delete a pipeline](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/delete-a-pipeline.md): Delete a pipeline (only if it has no active items)
- [Delete a stage](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/delete-a-stage.md): Delete a stage (only if it has no items)
- [Delete a task](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/delete-a-task.md): Delete a task and optionally its subtasks
- [Delete Contact](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/delete-contact.md): Delete a contact belonging to the account using ID
- [Delete Contact Avatar](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/delete-contact-avatar.md): Removes the avatar image from a contact
- [Delete Contact Note](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/delete-contact-note.md): Deletes a contact note
- [Delete Inbox](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/delete-inbox.md): Deletes an inbox permanently
- [Delete Message](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/delete-message.md): Deletes a message from the conversation
- [Delete Message Template](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/delete-message-template.md): Deletes a message template
- [Delete Product](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/delete-product.md): Deletes a product. Requires `products.delete`.
- [Delete Variant](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/delete-variant.md): Deletes a variant. Returns 422 if the variant is referenced by pipeline items. Requires `products.delete`.
- [Detach Product](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/detach-product.md): Removes the binding between the agent and the given product. The agent's config in evo-ai-core-service is re-synced after detach.
- [Disconnect Channel Provider](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/disconnect-channel-provider.md): Disconnects the channel provider from the inbox
- [Execute a macro](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/execute-a-macro.md): Executes all macro actions in the specified conversations. Execution is processed in the background via Sidekiq.
- [Export Bundle](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/export-bundle.md): Exports the selected categories/items as a ZIP file (`application/zip`). The response is a binary download with `Content-Disposition: attachment`.
- [Get a single pipeline](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-a-single-pipeline.md): Get detailed information about a specific pipeline including stages, items, tasks
- [Get a single stage](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-a-single-stage.md)
- [Get a single task](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-a-single-task.md): Get detailed information about a specific task including subtasks
- [Get an inbox](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-an-inbox.md): Get an inbox available in the current account
- [Get Assignable Agents](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-assignable-agents.md): Returns list of agents that can be assigned to conversations in this inbox
- [Get available contacts](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-available-contacts.md): Get contacts that can be added to this pipeline as leads
- [Get available conversations](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-available-conversations.md): Get conversations that can be added to this pipeline (not already in it)
- [Get Contact Pipelines](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-contact-pipelines.md): Returns all pipeline items (deals) associated with the contact
- [Get Contactable Inboxes](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-contactable-inboxes.md): Get List of contactable Inboxes
- [Get Conversation Counts](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-conversation-counts.md): Get open, unassigned and all Conversation counts
- [Get Conversations Available for Pipeline](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-conversations-available-for-pipeline.md): Returns conversations that can be added to pipelines
- [Get Exportable Inventory](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-exportable-inventory.md): Returns a category-grouped inventory of items available for export. Used by the export wizard in the frontend to show which items can be included in a bundle.
- [Get items statistics](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-items-statistics.md): Get statistics about pipeline items including services values and currency breakdown
- [Get macro details](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-macro-details.md): Returns complete details of a specific macro
- [Get pipeline statistics](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-pipeline-statistics.md): Get statistics for a specific pipeline including item counts by stage
- [Get pipelines containing a specific contact](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-pipelines-containing-a-specific-contact.md): Returns all pipelines that have items associated with the specified contact
- [Get pipelines containing a specific conversation](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-pipelines-containing-a-specific-conversation.md): Returns all pipelines that have items associated with the specified conversation
- [Get Product](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-product.md): Retrieves a single product by id. Requires `products.read`.
- [Get scheduled action details](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-scheduled-action-details.md): Returns complete information of a specific scheduled action
- [Get statistics for all pipelines](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-statistics-for-all-pipelines.md): Get aggregated statistics across all pipelines
- [Get task statistics](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/get-task-statistics.md): Get aggregated statistics for all tasks in the pipeline
- [Import Bundle](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/import-bundle.md): Imports a previously exported bundle ZIP file. Returns a report with manifest, imported items and any warnings.
- [Link Product](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/link-product.md): Links a product (and optionally a specific variant) to the pipeline item. The price and currency are **frozen** at link time and cannot be changed via update — subsequent edits only touch quantity/notes.
- [List Agents in Inbox](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-agents-in-inbox.md): Get Details of Agents in an Inbox
- [List all inboxes](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-all-inboxes.md): List all inboxes available in the current account
- [List all items in a pipeline](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-all-items-in-a-pipeline.md): Get all items (deals/leads) in a pipeline with filtering and sorting
- [List all macros](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-all-macros.md): Returns paginated list of macros available to the user. Includes personal macros (created by the user) and global macros (available to the entire account).
- [List all pipelines](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-all-pipelines.md): Get all active pipelines with stages, items, tasks info and services
- [List all stages in a pipeline](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-all-stages-in-a-pipeline.md): Get all stages for a specific pipeline ordered by position
- [List Attached Products](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-attached-products.md): Lists all products currently attached to the AI agent. Requires `agents.read`.
- [List Contact Notes](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-contact-notes.md): Returns all notes for a contact
- [List Contacts](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-contacts.md): Listing all the resolved contacts with pagination (Page size = 15). Resolved contacts are the ones with a value for identifier, email or phone number
- [List Labels](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-labels.md): Lists all the labels of a conversation
- [List Message Templates](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-message-templates.md): Returns all WhatsApp message templates for the inbox
- [List Products](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-products.md): Lists all products in the account catalog. Requires `products.read`.
- [List Products on Pipeline Item](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-products-on-pipeline-item.md): Lists all products linked to the pipeline item. Returns the product and its variant (when present), plus locked price/currency and free-text notes. Requires `pipelines.read`.
- [List scheduled actions](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-scheduled-actions.md): Returns paginated and filtered list of scheduled actions. Supports filters by status, action type, period, deal, contact and conversation.
- [List scheduled actions for a deal](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-scheduled-actions-for-a-deal.md): Returns all scheduled actions linked to a specific deal
- [List scheduled actions of a contact](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-scheduled-actions-of-a-contact.md): Returns all scheduled actions linked to a specific contact
- [List tasks for a pipeline item](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-tasks-for-a-pipeline-item.md): Get all tasks associated with a pipeline item (deal/lead)
- [List Variants](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/list-variants.md): Lists all variants of a product. Requires `products.read`.
- [Mark Conversation as Unread](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/mark-conversation-as-unread.md): Marks the conversation as unread for the agent
- [Mark task as completed](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/mark-task-as-completed.md): Complete a task (also completes all its subtasks)
- [Move all items from one stage to another](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/move-all-items-from-one-stage-to-another.md)
- [Move item to a different stage](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/move-item-to-a-different-stage.md)
- [Move stage down one position](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/move-stage-down-one-position.md)
- [Move stage up one position](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/move-stage-up-one-position.md)
- [Move task to a different parent](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/move-task-to-a-different-parent.md): Change the parent of a task or promote to root level
- [Mute Conversation](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/mute-conversation.md): Mutes notifications for a conversation
- [Remove an Agent from Inbox](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/remove-an-agent-from-inbox.md): Remove an Agent from Inbox
- [Remove item from pipeline](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/remove-item-from-pipeline.md): Remove a conversation or contact from the pipeline
- [Reopen a completed/cancelled task](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/reopen-a-completedcancelled-task.md): Reopen a task (also reopens all its subtasks)
- [Reorder stages](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/reorder-stages.md): Set custom order for all stages in the pipeline
- [Retry Failed Message](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/retry-failed-message.md): Retries sending a failed message
- [Search Contacts](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/search-contacts.md): Search the resolved contacts using a search key, currently supports email search (Page size = 15). Resolved contacts are the ones with a value for identifier, email or phone number
- [Search Conversations](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/search-conversations.md): Search conversations using a search term
- [Send Conversation Transcript](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/send-conversation-transcript.md): Sends the conversation transcript via email
- [Setup Channel Provider](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/setup-channel-provider.md): Configures the channel provider integration for the inbox
- [Show Contact](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/show-contact.md): Get a contact belonging to the account using ID
- [Show Inbox Agent Bot](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/show-inbox-agent-bot.md): See if an agent bot is associated to the Inbox
- [Sync Message Templates](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/sync-message-templates.md): Syncs message templates from WhatsApp Business API
- [Toggle Priority](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/toggle-priority.md): Toggles the priority of conversation
- [Toggle Status](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/toggle-status.md): Toggles the status of the conversation between open and resolved
- [Unlink Product](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/unlink-product.md): Removes the product link from the pipeline item. Requires `pipelines.update`.
- [Unmute Conversation](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/unmute-conversation.md): Unmutes notifications for a conversation
- [Update a macro](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-a-macro.md): Updates data of an existing macro
- [Update a pipeline](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-a-pipeline.md): Update pipeline details
- [Update a pipeline item](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-a-pipeline-item.md)
- [Update a stage](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-a-stage.md)
- [Update a task](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-a-task.md): Update task details (cannot update completed tasks)
- [Update Agents in Inbox](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-agents-in-inbox.md): All agents except the one passed in params will be removed
- [Update Contact](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-contact.md): Update a contact belonging to the account using ID
- [Update Contact Note](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-contact-note.md): Updates an existing contact note
- [Update Conversation](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-conversation.md): Update Conversation Attributes
- [Update Custom Attributes](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-custom-attributes.md): Updates the custom attributes of a conversation
- [Update Inbox](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-inbox.md): Update an existing inbox
- [Update item custom fields](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-item-custom-fields.md)
- [Update Linked Product](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-linked-product.md): Updates **mutable** attributes of the link: `quantity` and `notes`. Locked price/currency stay frozen and cannot be changed here — to replace the price, unlink and link again.
- [Update Message](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-message.md): Updates a message in the conversation
- [Update Message Template](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-message-template.md): Updates an existing message template
- [Update Product](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-product.md): Updates fields of an existing product. Requires `products.update`.
- [Update scheduled action](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-scheduled-action.md): Updates properties of a scheduled action (only for actions with 'scheduled' status). Allows changing time, payload and recurrence settings.
- [Update Variant](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/update-variant.md): Updates a variant. Requires `products.update`.
- [Verify Notificame Channel](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-crm/verify-notificame-channel.md): Validates that the provided `api_token`, `channel_id` and `phone_number` correspond to a valid Notificame channel and that the phone number matches the channel registration.

- [Compress Memory](https://docs.evolutionfoundation.com.br/evo-ai-knowledge/compress-memory.md): Manually compress short-term memory into medium-term summary
